title: E-RLT-0118: the bound register pair moves off lines in 11 of 12 reads above the instrument's floor, open on the axis...
purpose: Experiment E-RLT-0118 in the relativity arena: the bound register pair moves off lines in 11 of 12 reads above the instrument's floor, open on the axis at K 0.28 (gates fixed before the run): with a 6,144-cycle filter the residual floor is 1.2e-5 (E-RLT-0115's 2,048 filter left 9.2e-4), and on all four body diagonals and the face diagonal at K 0.22 and 0.28 the residual (3.3e-5 to 9.1e-5) and the share left at rest (0 to 0.0075) sit far below what twelve line branches give through the same reads (3.4e-4 to 5.5e-4, and 0.25); no direction leaves any part at rest (at most 0.080, against 0.5 on the axis); the axis at 0.28 reads a residual of 5.7e-4 between the moves (5.1e-4) and stuck (9.7e-4) bounds, where its level mixes with a neighbor.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
